items.title: 5.6 Bigre materials mein strain energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6 with Figs. 5.6 and 5.7 (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Jab force kisi jism ko deform karti hai (us ki shakal ya lambai badalti hai) to elastic restoring force (wapas asal halat mein lane wali force) ke khilaf kaam (work) hota hai. Yeh kaam jism mein potential energy ban kar jama ho jata hai. Yeh energy molecules ki potential energy mein izafe ke barabar hai, jo molecules ke apni mean positions (ausat jagahon) se hatne ki wajah se hota hai.
Kheenche hue material mein jama energy ka formula (derivation)

Spring ki shakal ka ek material lein (Fig. 5.6). Force F use x (yani Δx) extension tak kheenchti hai. Elastic limit ke andar extension force ke seedha proportional hai, is liye force zero se F tak barabar raftar se barhti hai (Fig. 5.7). Is liye spring ko Δx tak kheenchne wali average force ½F hai. Kheenchne wali force ka kaam:

blocks.alt: Ufqi support se do springs latakte hain. Baen spring apni asal lambai par hai (Original length of spring). Daen spring par slotted weights ka bojh hai aur woh lamba hai; do ufqi lakeeron ke darmiyan teer baen spring ke sire se neeche us ka extension x dikhate hain. Bojh ke saath teer F neeche ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Asal lambai ka spring force F se extension x tak khincha hua (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kaam (work) = average force × force ki direction mein tay kiya faasla

blocks.alt: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph, origin O se. Seedhi lakeer O se force F par P tak uthti hai; dashed lakeer P ko F-axis se jorti hai aur nuqtedar lakeer P se extension axis par Q tak girti hai. Tikon (triangle) OPQ surmai rang mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph; rangeen tikon OPQ (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force zero se F tak seedhi lakeer mein barhti hai, is liye average force F/2 hai. Triangle OPQ ka area = ½ × F × Δx, jo spring kheenchne mein kiya gaya kaam aur us mein jama energy hai.
Kheenchne wali force ka kaam spring mein strain energy ban kar jama hota hai, aur yeh us ke molecules mein jama potential energy ke barabar hai:

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Material kheenchne mein kiya gaya kaam = average force × tay kiya faasla. Is liye force-extension graph ke neeche ka area material kheenchne ka kaam batata hai, aur yahi kaam material mein jama elastic potential energy (P.E.) ke barabar hai.
Farz karein material ki lambai L, cross-sectional area A aur lambai mein izafa ΔL hai. Material ka volume AL hoga. Is liye har unit volume mein strain energy:
Is ko Eq. (5.8) mein rakhein to har unit volume mein strain energy:
Is equation se stress lage material mein jama strain energy nikali jati hai.

blocks.caption: Strain energy ke formulas
rows: W = ½F Δx = ½k(Δx)² = triangle OPQ ka area (5.7)

blocks.prompt: 200 N m⁻¹ spring constant wali spring 0.5 m kheenchi jati hai; us mein jama elastic P.E. nikalein. Jama energy F × Δx ka aadha kyun hai, poora kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: E = ½k(Δx)² = ½ × 200 × (0.5)² = ½ × 200 × 0.25 = 25 J. Force poore waqt F nahi rehti: spring kheenchte hue yeh zero se F tak barhti hai, is liye poori extension par average force sirf F/2 lagti hai; force-extension graph ke neeche triangle bhi yahi dikhata hai.

items: Restoring force ke khilaf kiya kaam strain energy (elastic P.E.) ban kar jama hota hai.
Spring: average force F/2; W = ½F Δx = ½k(Δx)² = triangle OPQ ka area.
Har unit volume: U = ½ × stress × strain = ½Y (ΔL/L)².
